COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1905 of 2025
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Aayush Gaur, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, learned Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
3. Petitioner raised industrial dispute, 
which was referred for adjudication to 
Labour Court. Learned Labour Court has 
decided the reference against the petitioner. 
Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioner has filed 
this writ petition. 
4. From the relief sought by petitioner, it 
appears that writ petition would be 
cognizable by a Bench dealing with petition 
filed under Article 227 of the Constitution.
5. Registry shall examine the issue and 
list this petition before appropriate Bench.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 13.11.2025
Aswal

WPMS No.3182 of 2025
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Aayush Gaur, Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Sudhir Nailwal, S.C. for the State.
3. This writ petition has been filed under Article 227 of 
the Constitution of India, whereby the petitioner has put to 
challenge the judgment and award dated 08.04.2021, 
passed by Presiding Officer, Labour Court, Dehradun in 
Adjudication Case No.5 of 2019, Shri Daulat Ram Semwal 
Vs. Chief Engineer, Level-1, Irrigation Department and others, 
whereby the adjudication case of the petitioner has been 
dismissed and termination of the petitioner was affirmed.
4. Issue notice to respondent no.4, returnable within 
four weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6. List this case on 06.01.2026.
7. In the meantime, respondent(s) may file their counter 
affidavit(s).
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 19.11.2025
